{{Quote|That place is crawling with those rakghoul things&mdash;you saw what happened to Cal.|[[Matthew Herral]]|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Suicide Mission|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}</ref>}}
'''Cal''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] under sergeant [[Mack (Taris)|Mack]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Cal was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[rakghoul]]s whilst trying to complete the job of scanning key structural points in the [[Sinking City]], after which other mercenaries refused to operate in the area.
